paragraphs.text: Live multi-way tree of the current session's agents in DeepSeek Harness, with status, plan progress,
tokens, cost, and runtime on every card.
# Agent Trees / 智能体树

**Agent Trees / 智能体树** — a DeepSeek Harness UI plugin that renders the current
session's agent workf

low as a live multi-way tree, in a top-down chart layout by
default. It is a standard DSH bundle (`d

sh.bundle`) with a Web Client half and no
build step.
**中文简介**：在 DeepSeek Harness 的对话页和右侧边栏中以多叉树展示当前会话的智能体工作流；每个卡片显示状态、计划进度、Token、费用和运行时间。
Each agent is a compact card ("小方块") with a minimal 1px outline:

- the task it owns (the delegation label, or the session title when no label exists),
- a top-left s

tatus indicator — a small spinner while running, a green dot on
success, a red dot on failure, and a

grey dot otherwise,
- a `P0`–`P3` priority badge,
- a static progress bar based on its todo plan (n

o flowing animation),
- a footer with current tokens, USD cost, main/subagent role, and live duratio

flowing animation),
- a footer with current tokens, USD cost, main/subagent role, and live duration.

The current session is the highlighted card. When the current session is itself a
subagent, the tree

walks up to the topmost available parent and marks the current
agent in the family tree.
## Install

The plugin is prepared for the dsh-market
catalog through `awesome-dsh-plugin`.
Once the catalog ent

ry is live, search **Agent Trees / 智能体树** in
**Settings → Plugin Market**.
You can install it directly from the repository now:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

On DSH Desktop, install from **Settings → Plugins** (the desktop app owns its
profile, so the CLI do
es not change the running app's profile).

Repository: xiezouqu12/agent-trees.
Requires DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0`.
## Screenshots
## Where it appears

Open a conversation and select the **Agent Trees / 智能体树** tab next to
**Chat**, **Trajectory**, and

the other views. The tab is added through the
`conversation.view` Client slot.
It also opens in the **right sidebar**:

- Click the small tree icon in the conversation header (next to the sidebar
toggle) to open or focus

the **Agent Trees** sidebar tab in one click.
- The right sidebar's `+` guide lists an **Agent Tree

s** capsule, so the tab can
also be opened from there.
- The sidebar tab is a native `sidebar.right.

pane.tab` body with a compact
layout, and it stays open beside the chat while the session changes.

The sidebar is **not** opened automatically for an ordinary session. It opens
when you click the hea

der tree icon or pick the capsule from the sidebar `+`
guide. A long multi-agent task may auto-open

it once after **3+ agents** have had
at least one running for about **25 seconds**, and only while t

he sidebar is
collapsed; a simple project never triggers it.
### Layouts

The view opens in **Chart** layout: a top-down org chart with rounded cards and
smooth curved connec

tors on a graph-paper canvas that fills the remaining panel
height (the whole sidebar body in the ri

ght-sidebar tab). Drag anywhere on the
canvas background to pan the whole tree; use the mouse wheel

to zoom around the
cursor (35%–250%); double-click the background to reset pan and zoom. The canvas

hint shows the current zoom percentage. Each card shows the task, priority,
status, progress, tokens

, cost, role, and runtime. Collapse a branch with the
round chevron at the card's bottom edge; the c
hart reflows immediately.

The two icon buttons in the header switch between **Chart** and **List** (the
indented tree). The sa

me layout applies to the conversation tab and the
right-sidebar tab.
## How the data is derived

The plugin is Client-only and reads existing client-visible session projections —
it writes no sessi
on events and registers no Host route:
| Projection | Used for |

| `subagentCatalog` | parent → child topology, delegation mode, task label |
| `subagentTiming` | la

st-turn completion, settled/active duration |
| `tokenUsage` | per-agent token total |
| `costUsage`

| per-agent token buckets and USD cost (when `dsh-cost-meter` is mounted) |
| `todos` | per-agent t
ask progress, when the agent used `todo_write` |

Session summaries (`useSessions().byId`) supply titles, running state, `blank`,
and the parent link.
`useSessionStatus` supplies the live status map.
### Progress rules

1. If the agent has a todo list, progress is
`(completed + 0.5 × in_progress) / total`, and the card

shows `done/total`.
2. A running agent without a todo plan shows a static empty track labelled
`无计划

`; the top-left spinner indicates that it is running. Nothing flows or
animates.
3. A finished agent

whose latest closed turn completed shows 100% and a green
status dot.
4. A finished agent whose tod

o list is fully completed is also 100%, even when
the timing projection has not settled yet.
5. A fi

nished subagent whose latest closed turn did not complete shows a red
status dot; its bar stays at i

ts actual todo progress, or `无计划` when it had
no plan.
6. A blank, not-yet-started agent shows 0% an

d a grey dot.
7. External tasks (`mode: "external"`) have no local session, so their bar is
neutral

and labelled "外部".
8. The **main agent** is never marked red just for being idle between turns: it
s

hows a grey idle dot. Red is reserved for a subagent that ended without
completing. The main agent's

todo projection is cleared at each turn start, so
the card shows `无计划` until a new plan is written;

it keeps the last plan it
observed.

The header's overall percentage follows the main task's todo plan when the root
has one, so a small

finished child cannot inflate the main task. When the main
task is running without a todo plan it us

es the finished-agent ratio instead;
otherwise it averages the per-agent progress values that are kn

own. The value is
shown inline with the agent counts; hover it for the estimate source.
## Compatibility

Built and tested against DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` (the version in this
desktop install). The pa

ckage declares `engines.dsh: >=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0`.
It depends only on the Web Client slot surface an
d the standard session hooks:

- `conversation.view` slot with `sessionId`, `useSessions`, `useSessionStatus`
- `ctx.sessions.refre

shProjections`
- `ctx.uiWorkspace.openSession`
- `ctx.locale` and `ctx.slots`

No Harness Client package is imported as a module; React comes from the browser
module table.
